scenes.caption: Whatever is already in the house.
scenes.narration: Any computer already sitting around. The old gaming rig. The laptop in the closet. Windows, Mac, Linux, it does not matter.

scenes.narration: One installer. One wizard.

shots.alt: The Set Up Your Hub wizard with its sticky Install and Finish footer.

shots.alt: The AI tab's System Overview card: OS, CPU, RAM, GPU, VRAM and storage, with an Apple Silicon capability badge.

() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].find((e) => e.children.length === 0 && /RECOMMENDED MODELS/i.test(e.textContent || '')); if (!h) throw new Error('RECOMMENDED MODELS heading not found — the AI tab moved'); h.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); let p = h.parentElement; while (p && p !== document.body) { const cs = getComputedStyle(p); if ((cs.overflowY === 'auto' || cs.overflowY === 'scroll') && p.scrollHeight > p.clientHeight + 20) { p.scrollTop = Math.max(0, p.scrollTop - 120); return; } p = p.parentElement; } window.scrollBy(0, -120); }
